contracts.actual_behavior: Entity-based owned projectile, not a replacement damage source. Living shooter resolves server UUID first, otherwise nonzero network ID. NBT retains Owner/LeftOwner; ID is not saved. Until leftOwner, expand motion AABB by1 and refuse same root vehicle; hit admission requires alive/pickable/nonspectator and, before leaving owner, not same-vehicle. No separate ally predicate. Each tick performs original movement-vector hit dispatch; entity hit does not discard here and hurt return is POP. Solid-volume or water/bubble discards, block hit discards on server. Drag is .99F; no explicit TTL. Gravity is original signed Y input only when !noGravity except Sand special case. Hand constructor offsets shooter head yaw±60, width*.5 and eyeY-.2F; mob constructor uses body yaw, (width+1)*.35 and eyeY+.2F. Entity hit invokes native mobProjectile with this direct projectile and resolved living causing actor; it is not newly server-gated. Server hit CrimsonMosquito gets bloodLevel+1 even when shooter is absent/nonliving or damage rejected.
